description: Check a list of pool or spa water readings for things that cannot be true, and compare pH, free chlorine and bromine against the ranges published on the US CDC pages. Deterministic arithmetic only - no AI. It does not decide whether a pool is legally compliant, and it does not know your local code.

as_of.description: Treat this date as "today" (YYYY-MM-DD) when rejecting future timestamps. Defaults to the server date.

readings.description: Readings to check. Each: {at:"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM", kind:"pool|hot_tub|splash_pad|wading_pool|other", ph?:number, free_chlorine_ppm?:number, total_chlorine_ppm?:number, bromine_ppm?:number, cyanuric_acid_ppm?:number, water_temp_f?:number, disinfectant?:"chlorine|bromine|none", method?:"dpd|test_strip|meter|other", by?:"who tested"}.

name: check_readings
